name: fieldkit-frontend
comment:type: Declared so Node parses `.ts`/`.js` here as ES modules instead of sniffing them — without it, `scripts/build-sw.mjs` importing `i18n/routing.ts` warns MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON on every build. Nothing in this app is CommonJS.
comment:build: `build` chains the service-worker step because Workbox precaches the hashed output of `next build` — it has to read .next/ after Next writes it. scripts/build-sw.mjs explains why this is a post-build step rather than a bundler plugin (short version: @serwist/next and next-pwa are webpack plugins, and Next 16 builds with Turbopack).
comment:workbox: Build-time only: esbuild bundles the workbox-* runtime modules into public/sw.js, so none of them reach the app bundle. Keep the workbox-* versions as a matched set — mixing majors across them is unsupported upstream. esbuild is declared explicitly even though vitest already pulls one in: a build step must not depend on another package's transitive resolution.
comment:overrides: Transitive CVE fixes (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849, GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93, GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj). next@16.2.12 declares postcss as exactly 8.4.31 and sharp as ^0.34.5, so the patched versions are unreachable by resolution; checked 2026-08, next@latest was itself 16.2.12. Drop each entry once Next declares a spec that admits a patched version — overrides.test.ts fails when either declaration changes, so this will not rot silently. Rationale: docs/architecture/16-security.md §6.
